entries.en: Get the fuck out!

entries.en: Sweet, but no fucking way. Not about to play with this shitstain.

entries.en: How's it goin'?

entries.en: You're gonna pay for this, you piece of shit!

entries.en: Hoo boy.

entries.en: Sounds sadly familiar.

entries.en: Go anywhere near them and you're dead.

entries.en: Denny...
entries.ro: Denny...

entries.en: An' we already agreed on everything.

entries.en: What, Kerry's payin' you? That's what this is about?

entries.en: Fuck, this's all fuckin' great. So you get him away from me and get the fuck off my lawn!

entries.en: Don't make me choose.

entries.en: Rather jam with Henry.

entries.en: Actually, it's your decision.

entries.en: Fuck. Really pisses me off Denny's on a control kick, settin' conditions.

entries.en: On the other hand, Henry's got scop for brains. Can't trust him.

entries.en: Looks like we'll be missing one person.

entries.en: Gotta go without one or the other.
entries.ro: Trebuie să ne descurcăm fără unul din ei.

entries.en: Won't be the same, though.
entries.ro: Nu o să fie la fel, totuși.

entries.en: Well? What's the plan?

entries.en: 'Bout to run completely outta patience.

entries.en: If we gotta choose, let's play with Denny.

entries.en: Listen, I'll get you--
entries.ro: Ascultă, o să-ți iau--

entries.en: Y'know what, Kerry? Fuck you. Good thing Silverhand isn't here to see this.
entries.ro: Știi ce, Kerry? Du-te-n pula mea. Bine că Silverhand nu e aici să vadă asta.

entries.en: You done? Get out.
entries.ro: Gata? Ieși afară.

entries.en: All right. What about Nancy?
entries.ro: Bine. Dar Nancy?

entries.en: We've made contact. She's gonna set it all up, let us know.
entries.ro: Am luat legătura. O să aranjeze totul și ne anunță.

entries.en: Fuck. Now I gotta find someone to clean this up...

entries.en: See you at the show.
entries.ro: Ne vedem la concert.

entries.en: Rather jam with Henry.

entries.en: I got exactly no problem with Denny joining us.

entries.en: What about Nance? She on board?

entries.en: Yep. Putting it all together. She'll give us a holler when it's all set.
entries.ro: Da. Se ocupă de tot. Ne dă un semn când e gata.

entries.en: Nancy takin' care of business. Just like old times.
entries.ro: Nancy își face treaba. Ca pe vremuri.

entries.en: Hop in, I'll give you a ride.

entries.en: Now get the fuck out of my sight – all o' you.
entries.ro: Acum ieșiți dracu' din fața mea, toți.

entries.en: OK. About all we can do for now.
entries.ro: OK. Cam atât putem face deocamdată.

entries.en: Except wait for Nancy to call.
entries.ro: Doar să așteptăm să sune Nancy.

entries.en: V! Uh, good you're here. We got a problem.
entries.ro: V! Ăă, bine că ești aici. Avem o problemă.

entries.en: This Henry's surprise?

entries.en: This supposed to be Henry's surprise?

entries.en: Yeah, I obviously missed a few beats. Looks like he was holdin' some sort of grudge.

entries.en: So he flooded the pool with concrete?

entries.en: Henry did often get emotional.
entries.ro: Henry era cam nervos, ce-i drept.

entries.en: V, talk to them. Kerry'll just make it worse.
entries.ro: V, vorbește tu cu ei. Kerry doar o s-o încurce și mai tare.

entries.en: Everything OK?
entries.ro: Totul e în regulă?

entries.en: Everything OK?
entries.ro: Totul e în regulă?

entries.en: No. Just the sight of that douchewad reminded me how not OK it is.
entries.ro: Nu. Doar să-l văd pe nesimțitul ăla mi-a amintit cât de rău e tot.

entries.en: Don't worry, though. I'll be past it by showtime.
entries.ro: Da' nu-ți face griji. Până la concert îmi trece.

entries.en: Wonder what Henry did to her.
entries.ro: Mă întreb ce i-a făcut Henry.

entries.en: Sorry it ended that way.

entries.en: Sorry it played out like that.

entries.en: Fuck. I got no idea who you are or why you stepped into all this.

entries.en: So save your breath and go, OK?

entries.en: Know what happened between them?

entries.en: What about the concert?

entries.ro: Din ce am aflat eu, într-o zi Denny a dispărut fără o vorbă, apoi s-a ascuns de Henry.

entries.en: I imagine that wasn't too hard in his state of mind, either out of it or in rehab.
entries.ro: Îmi închipui că în starea aia nu i-a fost greu, fie drogat, fie la reabilitare.

entries.en: Yep. That is, till I gave Henry her address.
entries.ro: Da. Adică până i-am dat lui Henry adresa ei.

entries.en: Not really my biz...

entries.en: Go, go. They'll get past it in a sec.

entries.en: Kerry didn't piss all over himself outta joy when he saw me, either.
entries.ro: Nici Kerry nu s-a pișat pe el de bucurie când m-a văzut.

entries.en: Maybe then you'll tell me why the hell you left me to die in the street!

entries.en: Ugh, I wish you would fuckin' die!

entries.en: I kid you not. I'ma whack your fuckin' head off.

entries.en: Oh, what, they don't know?

entries.en: Yeah? Fuck – that how you remember it?

entries.en: Remember a helluva lot more than you.

entries.en: Samurai – we're reuniting it.

entries.en: No, no way. Either him or me – choose.
